interpretation_policy: Saved development evidence only. Delete validation-score weights from cached predictions without retraining; this is neither leave-one-out CV nor an independent test. Year/fold sensitivity ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals or significance tests. No selection/promotion of a replacement model or repair from inspected outcomes. Warm timing includes feasible-state construction, cost evaluation and argmin, excludes MI/objective/predictor fitting and imports. Classical spectral changes preserve hardware-derived geometry but change the effective kernel. Fixed final artifacts and all old intents remain untouched; no extra hardware.
